preprocessing.decode: nvJPEG RGB via torchvision.io.decode_jpeg(device=cuda) (torchvision 0.26.0 bundled libnvjpeg.so.13)
preprocessing.resize: stretch to 640x640: torch.nn.functional.interpolate(mode=bilinear, antialias=True, align_corners=False) in float32, no uint8 rounding
preprocessing.decision: user decision 2026-10-30: match v1 F01 (nvJPEG) / F02 (normalize, then stretch); F02 must implement this antialiased kernel

policies.fp32-strict: cuDNN and cuBLAS TF32 off, float32 matmul precision highest, NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0; the FP32 math of the deployment engines (S04: FP32, TF32 cleared)
policies.torch-default: the original recipe: PyTorch 2.11 defaults made explicit (cuDNN TF32 convolutions, FP32 matmuls)

compute_precision.check: applied in the trainer process before the script runs, read back (flags plus a conv/matmul probe against float64), re-read every 10 s, at every checkpoint save and at exit; any mismatch fails the attempt
compute_precision.decision: user decision 2026-10-30: features that the head trains on or is selected with are computed like the deployment features (strict FP32); a ~1% TF32 feature gap is not accepted as a known limitation. The teacher keeps its bf16 training policy.

teacher.selected_epoch_rule: fixed epoch 12 of the 30-epoch schedule (protocol rule, not chosen on validation)

cache_train.storage: float16 files: P3/P4/P5 features and teacher one2many cls/reg (manifest storage_dtype)

cache_val.storage: float16 files: P3/P4/P5 features and teacher one2many cls/reg (manifest storage_dtype)

cache_eval.storage: float16 files: P3/P4/P5 features and teacher one2many cls/reg (manifest storage_dtype)

gt1.precision_note: the whole GT1 process: the live teacher features and the head's training math share one process

selection.data: val split only, every frame; features from cache_val (teacher e12, ungated, fp32-strict, stored float16)
selection.forward: T=1, FP32 (policy fp32-strict, read back in the evaluating process), eval mode, temporal blocks bypassed

decode.anchors: (x+0.5, y+0.5) per level, P3/P4/P5 strides 8/16/32, row-major
decode.boxes: raw ltrb distances (reg_max=1, no DFL) times stride, then mapped to the original resolution
decode.class: argmax of the same scores; only class 0 (person) is kept

selection.ground_truth: gt.txt rows with mark==1, class==1, visibility>=0.1 (the training filter); no ignore regions
selection.primary: AP50: person, all sizes, all val frames; detections pooled and ranked by score, greedy one-to-one match at IoU>=0.5, 101-point interpolated precision
tie_breakers: recall at score>=0.25 over GT with resized min side in [4,16) px
selection.ineligible: any non-finite raw output on the val frames
selection.next_stage_parent: the selected epoch checkpoint of the previous stage
selection.train_loss_best: kept as best.ckpt by the trainers; diagnostic only
selection.teacher: fixed epoch 12; validation metrics of every teacher epoch are diagnostics only
selection.eval_split: used once, after the T1 selection record is written; never for tuning or selection
